# bioexcel/biobb_gromacs/genion

## Summary

Wrapper class for the GROMACS genion module.

The GROMACS genion module randomly replaces solvent molecules with monoatomic ions. The group of solvent molecules should be continuous and all molecules should have the same number of atoms.

Nextflow adapter of the [Genion](https://biobb-gromacs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/gromacs.html#module-gromacs.genion) building block of [biobb_gromacs](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_gromacs) 5.3.2.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_GROMACS_GENION } from 'bioexcel/biobb_gromacs/genion'

workflow {
    BIOBB_GROMACS_GENION(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_tpr_path` | yes | tpr | Path to the input portable run input TPR file |
| `input_top_zip_path` | yes | zip | Path the input TOP topology in zip format |
| `input_ndx_path` | no | ndx | Path to the input index NDX file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_gro_path` | yes | gro | Path to the input structure GRO file |
| `output_top_zip_path` | yes | zip | Path the output topology TOP and ITP files zipball |
| `versions_biobb_gromacs` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_gromacs', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Genion properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_gro_path: 'gro']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_gromacs container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_GROMACS_GENION' {
        ext.properties = [replaced_group: 'SOL']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `replaced_group` | string | "SOL" | Group of molecules that will be replaced by the solvent. |
| `neutral` | boolean | false | Neutralize the charge of the system. |
| `pname` | string | "NA" | Name of the positive ion. |
| `nname` | string | "CL" | Name of the negative ion. |
| `np` | integer | 0 | Number of positive ions to add. |
| `nn` | integer | 0 | Number of negative ions to add. |
| `pq` | integer | 1 | Charge of the positive ion. |
| `nq` | integer | -1 | Charge of the negative ion. |
| `rmin` | number | 0.6 | Minimum distance between ions and non-solvent in nm. |
| `concentration` | number | 0.0 | Concentration of the ions in (mol/liter). When nonzero, overrides np and nn. Neutralization adds ions on top of the specified counts or concentration. |
| `seed` | integer | 1993 | Seed for random number generator. |
| `gmx_lib` | string | null | Path set GROMACS GMXLIB environment variable. |
| `binary_path` | string | "gmx" | Path to the GROMACS executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
